verification_method: 以 src/build_source_pack.py 的同一 deterministic 切句规则从原始 parquet 正文重新切句，核对 sN 下标处的句子是否逐字一致；若下标不匹配但原文中确含该句片段，则记为 literal_substring 命中。

records.sentence: These techniques are unable to extract existing code into APIs.

As the size of these LLMs increases, they gain “in-context learning” capabilities, whereby the models achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) or near-SOTA performance by conditioning on a small number of demonstration examples at inference time, without any need for updating model parameters <cit.>.

records.note: 原始正文中该句被换行分隔，来源包构建期的 normalize_text （换行->空格、连续空白归一）将其合并为同一句；按同一规则从原始 parquet 重建切句后，sN 处逐字一致。
